newsitem.title: USA: Family Steak defeats consent solicitation.
newsitem.headline: Family Steak defeats consent solicitation.

text.p: Family Steak Houses of Florida Inc said on Wednesday that the consent solicitation launched by Bisco Industries Inc. and Glen Ceiley on April 30, 1997 to revoke the company's rights plan and change other corporate governance matters has been defeated.
Bisco Industries has aimed to acquire up to 2.6 million shares of Family Steak Houses stock for $0.90 a share.

Bisco was seeking consents from shareholders of Family Steak Houses of Florida Inc to opt out of the Florida Control Share Act, to repeal certain bylaw amendments adopted by the company, and to prohibit future amendment of the bylaws without shareholder approval.
The deadline for Bisco to obtain consents expired on June 29, 1997.
